title: 1811 Prairie's entrance corner now turns round, as the 1888 plate shows
items: The corner beside the arched porch at 1811 Prairie is now a curve of rock-faced stone, about 0.9 m across, running from the ground to the cornice. It used to be a sharp square edge.
The corner downpipe now runs down the curve itself, where the plate draws it.
The builder can now round the corner of any stone-fronted house. Every other house on the avenue is unchanged.
